I was only 16 years old. I loved Alba's pages so much, I had Phenomenon 25 printed to my wall . I'd pray to Alba every night before I go to bed, thanking for the life I've been given. "Alba is love", I would say, "Alba is life". My dad hears me and says I ruined the backrooms. I knew he was just jealous for my devotion of Alba. I called him a limpurist. He slaps me and sends me to go to sleep. I'm crying now and my face hurts. I lay in bed and it's really cold. A warmth is moving towards me. It's Alba. I'm so happy. He whispers in my ear, "You're a pig, Maurice, and you'll always be one!". He grabs me with his powerful Belgian hands, and brings me to my laptop and forces me to read his author page. I read the Alba zone for Alba. His theme penetrates my eyes. It hurts to read so much, but I do it for Alba. I can feel my brain tearing as my eyes start to water. My dad walks in. Alba looks him straight in the eye, and says, "It's Albover now". Alba leaves through my window. Alba is love. Alba is life.﻿
